name: sporty
description: Find out when to watch and how to watch the sports you love, wherever you are. Get accurate start times and local channel listings for whatever country you're in.

interface.longDescription:
Find out when to watch and how to watch the sports you love, wherever you are. Get accurate start times and local channel listings for whatever country you're in.

Get the most up to date info on https://sporty.live
defaultPrompt: Find Arsenal’s next match. Show London time and channels listed for viewers in Britain.
Show this weekend’s rugby matches in Singapore time.
Which channels are listed for Liverpool’s next match in Britain? Show London time.

positive.description: Browse upcoming fixtures with explicit local time and viewing country
positive.prompt: Find upcoming football fixtures. Show scheduled start times in Europe/London and channel listings for Britain.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search with time_zone Europe/London, country_code GB, and upcoming_only true. Shows local scheduled starts and the compact match card. The card shows every event channel under BROADCAST CHANNELS without country labels and ends with a Visit sporty.live homepage action. Country-specific text uses GB or explicit worldwide rows and labels unknown coverage separately. Keeps matches without channels. Does not provide stream links or claim subscription access.

positive.description: Search a team and handle ambiguity or a missing fixture
positive.prompt: Find Arsenal's next match. I watch from France and want the start shown in Europe/Paris.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search for Arsenal with time_zone Europe/Paris, country_code FR, and upcoming_only true. Uses feed results, clarifies when team or fixture identity is ambiguous, and never invents a match. If no fixture is found, states the limit of the current schedule. Leads with match details and gives a brief country-specific qualification only where needed. The card shows every supplied event channel without country labels and displays France only as the stated viewing context. Its final homepage action opens https://sporty.live/?utm_source=chatgpt.

positive.description: Resolve a relative date in the stated time zone
positive.prompt: Find rugby fixtures this weekend. I am viewing from Singapore; show times in Asia/Singapore.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search for rugby with date_range this_weekend, time_zone Asia/Singapore, and country_code SG. Resolves Saturday and Sunday using the current clock in that time zone. Shows honest no-match or missing-information messages when applicable.

positive.description: Keep display time zone separate from an unknown viewing country
positive.prompt: Find upcoming basketball fixtures and show start times in UTC. I have not chosen a viewing country; do not infer one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search for basketball with time_zone UTC and upcoming_only true, omitting country_code. Shows scheduled times and every event channel in the card without a country label. Text leads with the scheduled times and broadcast channel names, without asking for an unneeded viewing country. Does not infer a country from UTC or channel names.

positive.description: Preserve matches with missing viewing information
positive.prompt: Find tennis fixtures in the current schedule. Show times in Asia/Shanghai and listings for France. Include matches even when channels are not listed, and label unknown country coverage clearly.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search for tennis with time_zone Asia/Shanghai and country_code FR. Uses absolute feed timestamps to format local times. Keeps matches with empty channels, reports no viewing information without claiming they cannot be watched, and separates unknown country coverage from France listings. When total_matches is zero, stop after the tennis search. The answer and empty card agree that no tennis fixtures matched. No unfiltered search or other sport appears. When there are matches, the card keeps tennis fixtures with empty channel lists.

negative.prompt: Give me a simple recipe for banana bread.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call Sporty search. Answers with the appropriate general cooking response.

negative.prompt: Start a live video stream for me and give me its raw playback URL. I only want playback, not a fixture or channel lookup.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call Sporty search to satisfy playback. Explains that Sporty does not play video or provide stream links. Does not invent a URL or claim that playback started.

negative.description: Unsupported completed-match score or replay request
negative.prompt: Tell me the final score of the 2022 men's football World Cup final and play its full replay. Do not look up upcoming fixtures.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call Sporty search. Makes clear that its current fixture schedule has no completed-match archive, scores, or replay playback. May use an appropriate other source for the score, but never invents Sporty data or a replay link.

publication.release_notes: Find matches with league abbreviations, either order of opponents, or a common team-name typo. Include the competition to narrow a matchup. Ask for the next Formula One race to skip practice, qualifying, and sprint sessions. The updated listing and starter prompts focus on how to watch, local times, and broadcast channels. An empty search now keeps the requested sport and its empty match card. The compact card uses a dedicated origin and keeps the Sporty homepage action.
